Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 18-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Autonomous Systems [CSE_4023]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                  Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Explain localization technique                                                                        (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Identify the reasons for GPS and camera map matching improving the localization                       (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Examine why localization is more difficult in tunnels                                                 (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Explain backscatter                                                                                   (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           List the methodology of reducing backscatter noise in turbid water images?                            (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Identify reasons with justification why turbidity degrades image clarity?                             (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3)                Explain optical flow                                                                                  (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           List suitable options when optical flow fails and sensor can provide motion estimates                 (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Examine the reasons for optical flow's struggle on uniform surfaces                                   (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                Explain is path planning?                                                                             (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                          Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  
  Page #1

B)                Identify the most suitable algorithm plans a safe path around obstacles?                              (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)                Identify how UAV path planning consider battery constraints?                                          (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                        Explain lane keeping                                                                                  (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                              Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                List the steps involved in detecting lane boundaries                                                  (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)                Analyze why lane-detection systems fail in heavy snow with proper justifications                      (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
